tasks.title: Predict the list

hints.compile: The list line is: List<string> games = new List<string> { ... }; Each game needs speech marks, with commas between them.
hints.other: If you see System.Collections.Generic..., you printed the list itself. Print each game inside a foreach loop instead.
hints.lines: Print one game per line inside the loop, then games.Count after the loop has finished.
hints.capitals: Check the capital letters in each game name.

hints.other: Item 2 is the third name. For the last item, use players[4] or players[players.Count - 1].
hints.error: There are 5 players, so the indexes go from 0 to 4. C# has no players[-1].
Three items means the indexes are 0, 1 and 2. There is no item 3.
